exposure: Oral Glucose Tolerance Test (OGTT) values (fasting glucose (OGTT0), 1-hour post-glucose (OGTT1), 2-hour post-glucose (OGTT2))
combined impaired OGTT subgroups (IFG, IGT, IFG & IGT)
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 2,541 twin pregnancies conceived through IVF treatment.
finding: Higher OGTT values in twin pregnancies after IVF treatment are closely linked to increased risks of adverse maternal outcomes like ICP and neonatal outcomes such as hypoglycemia and hyperbilirubinemia, and are negatively correlated with gestational age at delivery, neonatal birth weight, and birth length.
